Gaya and Nalanda 2022 2023 show institutional delivery and postnatal percentages of registrations

WITH gaya_2022 AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS denominator,
    (institutional_deliveries * 100.0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS institutional_delivery_percentage,
    (postnatal_check_48h * 100.0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS postnatal_percentage
  FROM maternal_services
  WHERE district = 'Gaya' AND year = 2022
),
gaya_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS denominator,
    (institutional_deliveries * 100.0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS institutional_delivery_percentage,
    (postnatal_check_48h * 100.0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS postnatal_percentage
  FROM maternal_services
  WHERE district = 'Gaya' AND year = 2023
),
nalanda_2022 AS (

    (postnatal_check_48h * 100.0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS postnatal_percentage
  FROM maternal_services
  WHERE district = 'Nalanda' AND year = 2022
),
nalanda_2023 AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS denominator,
    (institutional_deliveries * 100.0) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) AS institutional_delivery_percentage,

SELECT
